- Diabetes mellitus type 2
  - Status: On metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD. Random glucose 156 mg/dL today.
  - Plan: Continue current regimen. Advise low-carb diet, avoid sugary drinks, walk 30 min daily.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Abdominal bloating 3 days/week, occasional diarrhea. On mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS.
  - Plan: Increase soluble fiber, avoid trigger foods, keep symptom diary.
- General
  - Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm -> elevated).
  - Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.text: I’ve been having more abdominal cramps after meals and loose stools twice a day for the past week. The bloating is worse in the evenings. I’ve been taking mebeverine three times a day as advised but still uncomfortable.
